title: The Saucer in the Silo
hook: A grain elevator develops a metallic heartbeat, and the night crew finds a circular door where Bin Four should be.
truth: A small alien courier craft crash-landed decades ago and has been sleeping inside the elevator, waiting for the survey lattice and calendar correction to make delivery possible.

monster.name: The Sleeping Courier Craft
monster.instinct: To wake, repair itself, and deliver a message to the wrong century.

countdown.label: Heartbeat
countdown.text: Workers hear a slow metal pulse from inside an empty grain bin.

countdown.label: Gravity Pocket
countdown.text: Tools float upward in the maintenance stairwell.

countdown.label: Bin Airlock
countdown.text: Bin Four opens into a clean white corridor larger than the elevator tower.

countdown.label: Helmet Warning
countdown.text: Moths gather inside a cracked helmet and tap warnings against the glass.

countdown.label: Wrong Delivery
countdown.text: The craft powers up and announces delivery readiness to a recipient who died before the town was founded.

countdown.label: Launch Through Town
countdown.text: The craft attempts to launch through the grain elevator, pulling half the rail spur with it.

clues.text: A ring of grain stays cool and dry even beside overheated machinery.
The radio repeats a name that sounds like Lume-of-Third-Orchard when played backward.
Measurements inside Bin Four exceed the elevator's exterior by thirty feet.
Moths settle into letters spelling NOT WEDNESDAY.
A safety whistle changes the craft's heartbeat into a stable rhythm.
The delivery coordinate points to the Orchard Sink, not to space.

keeperHints: Let the craft be wondrous, old, and slightly bad at customer service.
Use workplace safety details to ground the impossible interior.
The helmet is comic in image but useful as a serious warning system.
revealPolicy: Reveal the craft through impossible architecture and repair behavior before confirming it is a courier vessel.
automationSafety: Do not trap player characters inside the craft without a clear exit or consent.
Do not launch the craft through town unless the countdown reaches its end.
